name: starter-site
description: Eltes AI — a local-first workspace with live web search, cited sources, a search-thinking trace, 66 models across 14 providers, Eltes Lab (train a language model in the browser), a built-in Studio, and desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux.

scripts.validate:html: html-validate index.html app.html auth.html docs.html news.html studio.html train.html
scripts.validate:css: for file in assets/css/theme.css assets/css/landing.css assets/css/app.css assets/css/docs.css assets/css/auth.css assets/css/studio.css assets/css/reel.css assets/css/news.css assets/css/galaxy.css assets/css/lab.css; do csstree-validator "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.supabase:deploy: npx supabase functions deploy eltes-mail --no-verify-jwt && npx supabase functions deploy email-webhook --no-verify-jwt && npx supabase functions deploy site-publish --no-verify-jwt

author: Eltes
